scope: Selected released sprint/fall/bonus callbacks, GUI toggle and packet handler; independent numerical models, not game execution.
limits: Player-age tick multiples are not timers measured from the start of a sprint.
Outer running handler requires grounded, not riding, non-Creative server player at END phase.
Water-breathing branch inherits the grounded outer gate.
Skills-disabled getter returns effective level100 while addXp exits; bonus/fall paths need explicit configuration testing.
Fall multiplier is an input to remaining damage processing, not guaranteed health loss.
